subject: Upcoming Team Building Event at Our Office
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that we will be hosting a team building event at our office next Friday. The event will include fun activities, team bonding exercises, and a catered lunch. This is a great opportunity for us to strengthen our teamwork and have some fun together. Please RSVP by the end of the week so we can finalize the arrangements. Looking forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Your Name]
